title: Ootle Pass
summary: Membership prototype for creators and communities, with tiered passes, expiry, renewals, gifting and referral rewards. The creator provides an MIT-licensed Rust Ootle template and a walletless browser simulation. The November 9 source review confirms the README explicitly says the template has not been published to Esmeralda or mainnet. The recording walks through the public documentation, including these limits; it does not demonstrate deployed transactions. Built by Hark under Rajesh Mullippa’s direction.
cardSummary: Explore membership tiers, expiring passes, renewals and referrals in a walletless browser simulation.
creator: rajeshmullippa

recording.credit: Docs walkthrough — membership design and simulation limits
